stemMd:
Neither the original drawing nor the later photographs ______ the underside of the device clearly. The researchers therefore needed to inspect the surviving object before proposing a reconstruction.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: In this neither...nor construction, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, photographs. The plural form show is therefore correct.

distractorRationale.b: The singular auxiliary does not agree with the nearer plural subject.
distractorRationale.d: The singular auxiliary is likewise inconsistent with photographs.
distractorRationale.c: With neither...nor, the nearer subject photographs is plural.
